verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents case management for prioritising and reviewing risk alerts raised during ongoing monitoring, through either the web app or the API. That lets an analyst inspect a new monitoring alert and its risks. Nothing in the evidence shows the product surfacing what changed (e.g. new or updated hits, or a diff against the previous screening). missing for 10: documented change/delta view for monitoring alerts, alert detail showing new versus previous profile or hit data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
